subject: Close cadence: MAP risk catalog, procurement bridge and rebaseline proposal
summary: Helix Health procurement flagged a conditional hold; proposed a MAP rebaseline and procurement bridge. Internal risk catalog and executive approval required for new close date. Final agreement includes conditional credit and SOC2 evidence before go-live sign-off.
messages:
From: Jamie Lawson <jamie.lawson@helixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP intake — procurement clarification and pause

Ben — thanks for the demo last week. Procurement reviewed the MAP and flagged two gating items that will hold signature: 1) procurement wants a formal list of residual risks tied to timeline slippage and the mitigation owners (they asked for a CSV or table), and 2) they need a firm procurement-bridge commitment from Redwood if the go-live slips more than two weeks from the committed date.

We can commit to a new evaluation window but we need the MAP updated with an explicit rebaseline proposal and the risk catalog. Can your team prepare that and also confirm whether Redwood can provide a 30-day procurement bridge (credit + priority scheduling) if acceptance slips?

Jamie
Director, Vendor Management
Helix Health

[Attachment: procurement-conditions-delta.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lawson <jamie.lawson@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Re: MAP intake — procurement clarification and pause

Jamie — appreciate the quick read and the clarity.

Short answer: yes, we can produce the risk catalog and propose a procurement bridge. I attached an updated MAP (redwood-map-v2.xlsx) that: 
- Calls out the new rebaseline (target close pushing from Sep 6 -> Sep 20) with milestone owners.
- Includes a risk register with severity, owner, and mitigation ETA.
- Proposes a 30-day procurement bridge (credit against first month + guaranteed priority slot on our Dedicated pool).

Internal ask: Camila/Neha — can you review the attached MAP and risk catalog (close-risk-catalog-20290821.pdf) and confirm the suggested credit amount and SLA amendment we should offer? I want to present a single counter-proposal to Helix by EOD tomorrow.

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cell: (555) 882-0199

[Attachment: redwood-map-v2.xlsx]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2029 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Re: MAP intake — procurement clarification and pause

Ben — reviewed. Notes inline from the risk catalog: 
1) Data ingestion timing (Medium): mitigation = incremental E2E test with Helix on Aug 27; owner = Neha.
2) SOC2 evidence lag (High): mitigation = provide SOC2 Type II report + architecture trace by Aug 24; owner = Grace.
3) Acceptance window drift (Medium-Low): mitigation = snapshot cache and fallback model variant; owner = Camila.

Procurement bridge: recommending a modest credit structure — 25% off month one bill if go-live slips past the two-week buffer, plus queue priority (we throttle burst capacity to prioritize onboarding). That gives Helix operational assurance without committing larger margin impact.

I'll draft a short escalation note to Marissa requesting exception approval for the credit and the SLA amend language (short bullet list).

Camila
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: close-risk-catalog-20290821.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation request — procurement bridge approval

Team — quick read and decision: I approve offering the 25% first-month credit and priority slot as a one-time procurement bridge for Helix, on these conditions: 
- Condition A: Helix must sign an amended SOW that captures the new close date and acceptance milestones (we need the updated SOW attached to the DocuSign envelope).
- Condition B: We receive the SOC2 Type II report or equivalent security baseline artifact by Aug 24. If SOC2 is delayed, we can provision a shorter bridge (15% credit) while Security triages.
- Condition C: Any additional dev effort outside the agreed evaluation plan will be scoped and billed as change orders.

Camila/Grace — please prepare the SOW amendment template and the precise SLA language (two paragraphs) for me to sign off; Ben — finalize the DocuSign flow and confirm Helix contact. I want the final package to legal tomorrow morning.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

[Inline note: If SOC2 is not available by Aug 24, escalate to Legal for an acceptable compensating control and loop in Security.]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lawson <jamie.lawson@helixhealth.com>, ProcureOps <procure@helixhealth.com>, Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@procureco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: MAP rebaseline + procurement bridge (HLX-4237)

Jamie / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary & agreed next steps: 
1) Rebaseline: Target close moved from 2029-09-06 -> 2029-09-20. Milestones are in the attached MAP (redwood-map-v2.xlsx).
2) Procurement bridge: Redwood will offer a conditional 25% credit on month one plus priority onboarding slot if acceptance slips beyond the two-week buffer. This offer is conditional on: (a) signed SOW amendment via DocuSign, (b) provision of SOC2 Type II report or acceptable compensating controls by Aug 24.
3) Risk catalog: See close-risk-catalog-20290821.pdf — key owners assigned and remediation dates included. Neha will lead E2E ingestion test on Aug 27.
4) Legal/Finance: Marissa approved the credit as a one-time bridge; Grace and Camila are preparing the SOW amendment and SLA language. DocuSign envelope will be shared by EOD.

Action items for Helix: please confirm acceptance of the procurement bridge terms and route the SOC2 artifact to security@redwood.com. Once we have the signed SOW and SOC2 or compensating control, we will lock the new close date and begin the priority onboarding sequence.

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: redwood-map-v2.xlsx, close-risk-catalog-20290821.pdf, procurement-conditions-delta.docx]
